links.outcome: Model accuracy under training-testing policies using human-refined versus LLM-only annotations
links.effect: Policies P1, P2, P3 yielded accuracies of 98.49%, 90.10%, and 89.04%, respectively, which the authors say shows the importance of human intervention in refining LLM annotations.
links.quote: Training-testing policies P1, P2, and P3 yielded accuracies of 98.49%, 90.10%, and 89.04%, respectively, highlighting the importance of human intervention in refining LLM annotations.

unlisted_practices: Human-in-the-loop LLM-assisted annotation of clinical notes for social determinants extraction

screen.reason: Pure model and annotation pipeline development study evaluating NLP performance on retrospective MIMIC-IV notes without evaluating clinical deployment, clinical workflow, or real-world safety guardrails.
